title: Crown prep on an upper molar with a temporary

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: How's the fantasy football league going?

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Ha. Okay, today we're prepping number three for the crown we talked about, the old filling is cracked through the distal.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Taking off the old amalgam on three. There's a fracture line running mesial to distal under it.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Prep is done. Taking the final impression for a porcelain crown on number three.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Placing the temporary crown with temp cement.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: The lab will have it back in two weeks, we'll seat the final crown then.
